sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专为你制作了这档《办公室》终极重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会深度解析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的我们才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: Are you ready for a very fun episode today and very controversial?
sentences.zh: 准备好迎接今天这一集非常有趣且充满争议的内容了吗？

sentences.en: Oh, we got a lot of mail.
sentences.zh: 噢，我们收到了很多来信。
各位，这一集是“客户忠诚度”。

sentences.en: It is Season 9, Episode 12, written by Jonathan Green and Gabe Miller, and directed by Kelly Cantley.
sentences.zh: 这是第九季第十二集，由乔纳森·格林和盖比·米勒编剧，凯莉·坎特利执导。

sentences.en: Now, before you get into a summary, I thought we needed a little something from the episode to kick us off.
sentences.zh: 在进入剧情梗概之前，我觉得我们需要从这一集中选一段话来开启今天的节目。

sentences.en: Yes, we will be delivering a shipment of paper today, but I will also be delivering you a big shipment of fun.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们今天不仅要运送一批纸张，我还要为你运送一大批快乐。

sentences.en: Are we going to be delivering people a shipment of fun?
sentences.zh: 我们要给人们运送一大批快乐吗？
你听到了吧，这是德怀特说的。

sentences.en: Buckle in, because we've got a lot of fun stuff today.
sentences.zh: 系好安全带，因为今天的内容非常精彩。

sentences.en: I just thought it was fun.
I love when you get a kickoff idea.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢你提出开场点子的样子。

sentences.en: It's a big shipment of fun.

sentences.zh: 那么，这是你的剧情梗概。

sentences.en: An important meeting in Philly prevents Jim from attending CeCe's dance recital.
sentences.zh: 费城的一场重要会议让吉姆无法参加西西的舞蹈表演。

sentences.en: Dwight goes to great lengths to keep Daryl at Dunder Mifflin.
sentences.zh: 德怀特不惜一切代价想把达里尔留在邓德·米夫林。

sentences.en: Nellie fears she will fall out of good standing with Andy after pairing Aaron and Pete on a project, and they get real flirty.
sentences.zh: 奈莉担心在把亚伦和皮特分到一组做项目后，会失去安迪的信任，因为他们俩打得火热。

sentences.en: Finally, Pam receives some good news, but her excitement is dampened by a conflict with Jim.
sentences.zh: 最后，帕姆收到了一些好消息，但她与吉姆之间的冲突让她的兴奋之情大打折扣。

sentences.en: It's a big old fight, is what it is.
sentences.zh: 那可是一场大争吵，就是这样。

sentences.en: And like I said, we got some fan soapbox mail about this episode, but it is not the scene you think it is.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，我们收到了一些关于这一集的粉丝吐槽邮件，但并不是你以为的那场戏。

sentences.en: I mean, I want you to tell me, like when it happens.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我想让你告诉我，比如在说到那一段的时候。

sentences.en: Let's get into fast fact number one.
sentences.zh: 让我们进入第一个速览事实。

sentences.en: I'm very excited about this fast fact.
sentences.zh: 我对这个速览事实感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: We have a major guest star alert in this episode.
sentences.zh: 这一集有重量级客串明星登场。

sentences.en: Your daughter, Isabel, was one of the dancers.
sentences.zh: 你的女儿伊莎贝尔当时是舞者之一。

sentences.en: And I remember it so clearly.
Oh, I had so much fun, first of all, re-watching this, re-watching it with her.
sentences.zh: 哦，首先，重温这一集，还和她一起看，真的太有趣了。

sentences.en: Then I went into my digital clutter, and I found videos of the rehearsal day.
sentences.zh: 后来我翻了翻我的数字相册，找到了排练当天的视频。

sentences.en: Well, Steve Burgess reminded me that Greg's daughter, Maya, was also in this episode, and it was her dance class that was featured.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·伯吉斯提醒我，格雷格的女儿玛雅也参与了这一集，而且出镜的就是她的舞蹈班。

sentences.en: And then you folded Isabel in as well.
sentences.zh: 然后你就把伊莎贝尔也加进去了。

sentences.en: Well, Isabel and Maya are a year apart, and they're really close.
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔和玛雅只差一岁，她们关系非常好。

sentences.en: You know those cousins you grow up with that you're close in age, and they're just so much fun?
sentences.zh: 你知道那种一起长大、年龄相仿、在一起特别开心的表姐妹吗？

sentences.en: So they have that kind of relationship.
They're still just two peas in a pod.
sentences.zh: 她们至今还是形影不离的好姐妹。

sentences.en: In fact, today, their schools are playing softball against each other, and they're both on rival softball teaMs.
sentences.zh: 事实上，今天她们学校要进行垒球比赛，她们俩分别在两支对立的球队里。

sentences.en: So I'm like, oh, my gosh.
The whole family's going to be there.
Isabel's like, Mom, we better win.
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔说，妈妈，我们一定要赢。

sentences.en: So it's a very sweet friendship that they have, and they were so cute when they were little.
sentences.zh: 她们之间的友谊非常甜蜜，小时候她们真的太可爱了。

sentences.en: And this is a really special memory for our family that they both got to do this.
sentences.zh: 对于我们家来说，她们俩能一起参与这件事，是一段非常特别的回忆。

sentences.en: And I thought maybe I should ask Isabel what she remembered from this day.
sentences.zh: 我想也许我该问问伊莎贝尔对那天还有什么记忆。

sentences.en: Now, she was only about four years old.
She's so tiny, but here's what she had to say.
sentences.zh: 她当时那么小，但听听她是怎么说的。
嘿，《办公室女士》的听众们。

sentences.en: I am here with my daughter, Isabel.
sentences.zh: 我和我的女儿伊莎贝尔在一起。

sentences.en: And she's going to talk about her time being a ladybug.
sentences.zh: 她要聊聊她扮成瓢虫的那段经历。

sentences.en: All right, is we normally ask our guests, how'd you get your job on The Office?
sentences.zh: 好了，我们通常会问嘉宾，你是怎么得到《办公室》这份工作的？

sentences.en: But I think we can skip that one.
sentences.zh: 但我想这个问题我们可以跳过。

sentences.en: Oh, well, obviously, I don't remember a lot.
sentences.zh: 哦，嗯，显然我记不太清了。

sentences.en: But I do remember being so excited to get to wear the costume.
sentences.zh: 但我确实记得当时能穿上那套戏服特别兴奋。

sentences.en: The little tutu was so cute.
sentences.zh: 那件小芭蕾舞裙太可爱了。

sentences.en: You were in a big tutu phase then.
sentences.zh: 你当时正处于特别迷恋芭蕾舞裙的阶段。

sentences.en: And I love to be able to hang out with my cousin Maya.
sentences.zh: 而且我很高兴能和我的表姐玛雅待在一起。

sentences.en: We got to do it together, which was so fun.
sentences.zh: 我们能一起参与，真的太好玩了。

sentences.en: That, I thought that was so cool.
The ladies were so sweet to you guys.
sentences.zh: 那些女士对你们真是太好了。

sentences.en: They made us feel so special.
sentences.zh: 她们让我们感觉自己很特别。

sentences.en: And they let you have lip gloss.
sentences.zh: 而且她们还让你们涂唇彩。

sentences.en: I do remember after the dance, you were tired.
sentences.zh: 我确实记得跳完舞后，你很累。
我当时可能想小睡一会儿。

sentences.en: You know, Isabel is my goddaughter.
sentences.zh: 你知道，伊莎贝尔是我的教女。

sentences.en: So this was so sweet, Ang.
I found so many cute photos.
sentences.zh: 我找到了好多可爱的照片。

sentences.en: And then something I was really surprised by that I'd forgotten about, way buried in my
sentences.zh: 还有一件让我非常惊讶的事，我都快忘了，它埋在我的

sentences.en: digital clutter, one of the moms from the dance class filmed the dance rehearsal day.
sentences.zh: 数字杂物里，舞蹈课的一位妈妈拍下了舞蹈排练那天的情况。

sentences.en: So we had a rehearsal day.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有一个排练日。

sentences.en: It was on Tuesday, and we filmed this on the Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 那是周二，我们是在周三拍的这个。

sentences.en: And Isabel came to work, and it was so cute because she thought, well, I'm visiting my mom
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔来上班了，这太可爱了，因为她以为，嗯，我是来探我妈妈

sentences.en: My mom's part of the dance, too.
And she kept wanting me to come stand by her and, like, learn the dance with her.
sentences.zh: 她一直想让我站到她身边，像她一样学跳舞。

sentences.en: And it's all on video, and it's so precious, Jenna.
sentences.zh: 这一切都被录下来了，真是太珍贵了，珍娜。

sentences.en: And I'm so thankful for this rewatch podcast because I found this video buried way deep in
sentences.zh: 我非常感谢这个重温播客，因为我找到了这段埋在

sentences.en: email that I had forgotten about.
sentences.zh: 邮件深处的视频，我都快忘了。

sentences.en: I'm going to put part of it in stories because it's just the cutest little girls learning this
sentences.zh: 我要把其中的一部分发到快拍里，因为那群小女孩学跳舞的样子太可爱了，

sentences.en: dance and me in the middle of them.
And I have really cute photos from hair and makeup.
sentences.zh: 我还有很多化妆时的可爱照片。

sentences.en: And then the other thing the little girls were so excited about is I found photos.
sentences.zh: 还有一件事让小女孩们非常兴奋，我找到了照片。

sentences.en: You know how when we would go from our main soundstage maybe over to, like, the other soundstage?
sentences.zh: 你知道我们从主摄影棚去另一个摄影棚的时候吗？

sentences.en: Well, rather than having all these little girls walk all that way from hair and makeup to
sentences.zh: 嗯，与其让这些小女孩从化妆间一路走到

sentences.en: that other soundstage, this is just in a parking lot, you guys.
sentences.zh: 那个摄影棚，这只是在停车场里，伙计们。

sentences.en: They let them ride in the big passenger van.
sentences.zh: 她们让她们坐上了大型客货车。

sentences.en: And they buckled them all in.
sentences.zh: 而且她们都系好了安全带。

sentences.en: You should see this photo of their faces.
sentences.zh: 你应该看看他们脸上的表情。

sentences.en: They're so delighted to go, like, just a few hundred feet in this passenger van.
sentences.zh: 他们为了坐这辆客货车走那几百英尺的路，简直高兴坏了。

sentences.en: Isabel, thank you for sharing your memories.
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔，谢谢你分享你的回忆。

sentences.en: I have more to share later in the episode, too.
sentences.zh: 这集节目后面我还有更多要分享的。

sentences.en: Well, let's move on to Fast Fact 2.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们进入第二个速览事实。

sentences.en: I'm calling this The Big Reveal.
You know, we reveal the documentary crew for the first time, and someone from the documentary
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们第一次揭开了纪录片摄制组的真面目，而且摄制组里的某个人

sentences.en: crew interacts with someone from The Office.
sentences.zh: 和《办公室》里的某个人有了互动。

sentences.en: Uh, I mean, not just someone.
sentences.zh: 呃，我是说，不仅仅是某个人。

sentences.en: Well, Jenny Tan, who runs Office Tally, posted a message to fans before this episode came out.
sentences.zh: 嗯，经营“办公室记分牌”网站的珍妮·谭，在这集播出前给粉丝发了一条消息。

sentences.en: Just to give you a sense of, like, how big a deal this moment was in the history of the show.
sentences.zh: 就是为了让你们感受一下，这一刻在剧集历史上有多么重要。

sentences.en: And she said the producers of the show had sent her an email that said this.
sentences.zh: 她说剧组制片人给她发了一封邮件，内容是这样的。

sentences.en: I know the episode summary says, quote, we start to see behind the scenes, but I wanted to let you know how really good tomorrow's episode is.
sentences.zh: 我知道剧集简介里写着，引用一下，“我们开始看到幕后”，但我还是想让你知道明天的这一集真的非常棒。

sentences.en: You have been great about letting The Office Tally fans know what's going on at the office, but they should really watch tomorrow night.
sentences.zh: 你一直以来都很棒，总是让“办公室记分牌”的粉丝们了解办公室里发生的事情，但他们真的应该看看明晚的节目。

sentences.en: I think they will be sorry if they don't, so watch tomorrow night.
sentences.zh: 我觉得如果他们不看会后悔的，所以明晚一定要看。

sentences.en: And Jenny Tan went on to say, quote, I have never received an email about an episode before, so I think this is a big deal.
sentences.zh: 珍妮·谭接着说，引用一下，“我以前从来没收到过关于某一集的邮件，所以我认为这事儿非同小可”。

sentences.en: We got a lot of fan questions about the big reveal.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了很多粉丝关于这次大揭秘的提问。

sentences.en: I like that you started to whisper, because sometimes when life gets serious, you'll whisper.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢你开始压低声音说话的样子，因为有时候当生活变得严肃时，你就会压低声音。

sentences.en: How did you all feel when you saw the script was featuring the documentary crew?
sentences.zh: 当你们看到剧本里出现了纪录片摄制组时，你们感觉如何？

sentences.en: Did you know it was coming?
I remember being astonished when I first saw the episode.
sentences.zh: 我记得第一次看到这一集时，我感到非常震惊。

sentences.en: What do you know about this decision to bring the camera crew into the story?
sentences.zh: 关于让摄像组进入故事线这个决定，你知道些什么？

sentences.en: I can remember exactly where I was sitting when you guys smashed that fourth wall.
sentences.zh: 我清楚地记得你们打破第四面墙时我坐在哪里。

sentences.en: And we saw Brian for the first time.
sentences.zh: 那是我们第一次见到布莱恩。

sentences.en: I was stunned, shocked, mouth agape.
sentences.zh: 我当时惊呆了，震惊得目瞪口呆。

sentences.en: Even though there had been nods to the crew all along, this felt major and I never saw it coming.
sentences.zh: 尽管之前一直有向摄制组致意的镜头，但这次感觉意义重大，我完全没预料到。

sentences.en: I need to know everything about this decision.
sentences.zh: 我需要知道关于这个决定的所有细节。

sentences.en: Was there a debate about incorporating the documentary crew into the storyline?
sentences.zh: 当时关于是否要把纪录片摄制组纳入故事情节，有过争论吗？

sentences.en: Well, Ange, I reached out to Greg about this, and I have his side of the story.
sentences.zh: 嗯，安吉，我为此联系了格雷格，我有他那边的说法。

sentences.en: We reached out to director Kelly Cantley, and we got her thoughts on the matter.
sentences.zh: 我们联系了导演凯莉·坎特利，听取了她对此事的看法。

sentences.en: But why don't we start with us?
sentences.zh: 但为什么我们不先从自己说起呢？

sentences.en: This is, oh, man, this was a big moment.
sentences.zh: 这，天哪，这真是一个重大的时刻。

sentences.en: I put this on a list of, like, bombshell table read moments.
sentences.zh: 我把它列入了那种“重磅剧本围读时刻”的清单里。

sentences.en: So, I remember there were just a few where literally you felt the air go out of the room.

就像每个人的反应那样。

sentences.zh: 当帕姆和吉姆在“赌场之夜”接吻时，我们在围读会上读到那一幕，所有人都惊呼：天哪。

sentences.en: And then when Dwight and Angela, when they're revealed.
sentences.zh: 还有德怀特和安吉拉，当他们的关系曝光时。

sentences.zh: 当我们发现迈克尔和简在牙买加好上的时候。

sentences.en: When we find out about Oscar and the senator.
sentences.zh: 当我们发现奥斯卡和参议员的事时。

sentences.zh: 当我们发现帕姆怀孕时。

sentences.zh: 围读会上确实有过这些重大的时刻。

sentences.zh: 而这绝对是其中最重大的时刻之一。

sentences.en: We were like, oh, my God, oh, my God.

sentences.zh: 但那并不是我们最终拍摄的版本。

sentences.zh: 那是那些重大时刻之一。

sentences.en: I was like, oh, my gosh.
